description: This pattern targets the "Check-IO-Reply" sequence in consensus protocols. Implementations often attempt to minimize latency by sending network replies in parallel with disk writes or before the disk write completes (optimistic replying).
trigger_condition: Node crash occurs immediately after sending a positive acknowledgment to a state-changing request (Accept, AppendEntries, Prepare) but before flushing to disk.
test_template: 1.  **Setup**: Create a cluster (e.g., 3 nodes). Partition one node to force a smaller quorum or specific recovery path.
